purpose: Deterministic geofence registry for the rule engine. Each entry is a barrier (physical or operational) that should influence route clustering. Hard barriers block crossings; soft barriers add cost/time penalties and trigger split-route consideration. LLM spatial reasoner is advisory ON TOP of this; it never overrides what the registry says.

schema.barriers: Array of geographic constraints (water, mountains, highway chokepoints, slow-corridor pairs).
schema.outlierThresholds: Per-region distance thresholds for outlier detection (used by candidate generator's split-outliers variant).
schema.absorptionThresholds: Per-region thresholds for the absorption test (≤N-order routes with ≥Xkm spread are candidates).
schema.sparseVolumeLocations: Locations where solo-order postponement should be considered (low order/day average).

barriers.name: Guanabara Bay (Rio↔Niterói)
barriers.explanation: Rio-Niterói Bridge (Ponte Costa e Silva) is the only road crossing. Typical crossing: 13.3 km, 25-45 min, can hit 60+ in peak. Ferry alternative exists but Lalamove uses road.
barriers.rule: If route contains stops on opposite sides of this barrier, flag soft-rule violation. Propose split-by-side alternative. Operator override accepted with logged reasoning.

barriers.name: Tietê River (SP Marginal Tietê crossings)
barriers.explanation: Marginal Tietê is a major north-south chokepoint in São Paulo. Crossings via Ponte Vila Maria, Ponte da Casa Verde, Ponte do Limão, etc. Traffic-dependent. Add 15-30 min in rush hour.
barriers.rule: Cross-river pairings flagged only if also outliers or low-spread candidates. Not blocking for normal SP routes (river crossing is too common to block).

south-of-tiete.description: Central SP, Pinheiros, Vila Madalena, Jardins, Vila Mariana, Mooca, Tatuapé, etc.

north-of-tiete.description: Casa Verde, Santana, Tucuruvi, Vila Maria, Lapa.

barriers.name: Ponte Rio-Niterói (physical barrier, modeled as time-cost)
barriers.explanation: Already covered by rio-guanabara-bay; this entry exists so the rule engine can apply per-bridge time-cost overrides if data warrants. Reserved.

barriers.name: Recife rivers (Capibaribe + Beberibe)
barriers.explanation: Recife has multiple river crossings. Per current operator experience, none rise to barrier-status under normal conditions (bridges are short, traffic moderate). Tracked for future tuning if operator feedback suggests otherwise.
barriers.rule: Informational only. No automatic split-flagging. Promote to soft-severity if 3+ operator feedbacks cite Recife bridge delays.

barriers.name: SP→Alphaville/Santana de Parnaíba corridor
barriers.explanation: Alphaville is ~30 km west of central SP via Castelo Branco highway. Driver flow is natural (single direction, predictable traffic). Pattern: combined-with-SP-cluster wins over split-as-solo due to Lalamove multi-stop pricing.
barriers.rule: Orders to Alphaville/Santana de Parnaíba neighborhoods should NOT be auto-split as solo routes when paired with 2-3+ SP-central orders. Trigger outlier-flag for operator visibility but recommend keep-combined.

default.explanation: An order is flagged as outlier if its distance from cluster centroid is BOTH > 2× the median AND > 10 km absolute. Both conditions prevent false positives on small dense clusters.

rio-de-janeiro.explanation: Rio's geography is constrained by water+mountains; outliers stand out more sharply.

sao-paulo.explanation: SP's sprawl means 'far' is larger; threshold tuned to catch only true outliers.

default.explanation: Routes with ≤2 orders AND ≥5 km internal spread are absorption candidates: try absorbing each stop into nearest other route, quote each variant, pick cheapest grand-total. Catches Lalamove's pricing-vs-tour-length blindspot.

sparseVolumeLocations.explanation: A location qualifies as 'sparse-volume' if its 30-day rolling avg is ≤1.5 orders/day OR it has had 2+ consecutive single-order days. Solo-order postponement heuristic applies.

97397014848.name: Shopping Recife
97397014848.rationale: Recife is the lowest-volume GE Beauty location. Min-fare dominance means solo dispatches are ~R$24+ regardless of distance.

corridorPairs.explanation: Pairs of (pickup-neighborhood, distant-cluster-neighborhood) where intermediate orders should be absorbed into the distant cluster's route. Currently sparse — populated as the corridor-from-pickup heuristic accumulates validations.

changelog.summary: Initial Brazil registry. Barriers: Guanabara Bay (Rio↔Niterói), Tietê river crossings (SP), Recife rivers (info-only), Alphaville corridor pattern. Outlier thresholds per-metro. Absorption defaults. Sparse-volume locations seeded for Recife. One corridor pair (Botafogo→Tijuca) at candidate status.
